{"code": "df['channel_segment'] = df['channel'] + '_' + df['customer_segment']

# Compute overall conversion rate
overall_conversion = df['converted'].mean()

# Compute conversion rates by segment
segment_conversions = df.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Compute conversion rates by channel
channel_conversions = df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute conversion rates by channel-segment
channel_segment_conversions = df.groupby('channel_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Compute revenue by channel-segment
channel_segment_revenue = df.groupby('channel_segment')['revenue'].mean()

# Print results
overall_conversion, segment_conversions, channel_conversions, channel_segment_conversions, channel_segment_revenue"}
